title: Threads’ new ‘Dear Algo’ AI feature lets you personalize your feed
description: The platform's new feature lets users tell Threads what they temporarily want to see more or less of in their feed.
author: Aisha Malik

title: How AI changes the math for startups, according to a Microsoft VP
description: Amanda Silver is a corporate vice president at Microsoft’s CoreAI division, where she works on tools for deploying apps and agentic systems within enterprises.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Senior engineers, including co-founders, exit xAI amid controversy
description: At least nine engineers, including two co-founders, have announced their exits from xAI in the past week, fueling online speculation and raising questions about stability at Musk’s AI company amid mounting controversy.

title: Build a pipeline and close deals with an exhibit table at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
description: Get an unmatched ROI by exhibiting your startup in front of 10,000 tech leaders and investors at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, October 13-15 in San Francisco. Book your table now before it's gone.

title: Meridian raises $17 million to remake the agentic spreadsheet

title: With co-founders leaving and an IPO looming, Elon Musk turns talk to the moon
description: According to The New York Times, which reports that it heard the meeting, Musk told employees that xAI needs a lunar manufacturing facility, a factory on the moon that will build AI satellites and fling them into space via a giant catapult.

description: The executive has denied the allegation that she engaged in discrimination.

title: Okay, now exactly half of xAI’s founding team has left the company

title: Amazon may launch a marketplace where media sites can sell their content to AI companies

description: AI lab Flapping Airplanes just landed $180 million in seed funding from the likes of Google Ventures, Sequoia, and Index to do something most labs have quietly given up on: making models learn like humans instead of vacuuming up the internet. The founding team, made up of brothers Ben and Asher Spector and co-founder Aidan Smith, is […]

author: Lauren Forristal

title: The first signs of burnout are coming from the people who embrace AI the most
